correctness.rationale: Exact affine inverse branches partition each length-n triadic scale, giving all integer cocycle increments and the multiplicative partition function. Uniform maximizing-branch measures settle both endpoints. Finite independent check.py passes 168 branch, 55986 word, 64 partition and 25 pressure diagnostics. No assertion uses finite tests as an infinite proof.
